text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One day, while at an intensive training 
camp on Tracen Island for our next 
race..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...! ...Not yet, this isn't 
nearly enough...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ryan-chan, weren't you off today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah... It's just self-training. I fell 
behind while resting my inflammation, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
This much is obvious... No! I need to... I 
need to try much, much harder...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan-chan...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...I know! Ryan-chan, I've got a workout 
I'd love to recommend to you!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I changed into my swimsuit like you asked, 
but... What kind of training are we 
actually doing?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh♪ Ta-da! A water gun~~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
We'll splash water on each other with 
this! Dodging it will train our legs too, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm sorry, Ines. I was hoping for 
something a bit more serious for 
training...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Non-non, trying everything out first is 
what's important! Tha-at's why――!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Eep!? It's freezing!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Look out, look out~~♪ If you don't dodge 
carefully, you're gonna get soaking wet~~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Now you've done it, you little~~! 
Take that!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~~!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm totally exhausted~~...! I might 
not be able to move another inch...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... Me too... ......Heh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Ines, for inviting me today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've loosened up somehow. My 
muscles... and my nerves, too...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank goodness. Ryan-chan had her 
eyebrows all scrunched up during training, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...When you're feeling impatient, you just 
get reckless, right? Like you feel guilty 
if you aren't doing something.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I even pack my schedule full of part-time 
jobs on my days off.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, nothing good comes from 
pushing yourself too hard! You just ended 
up making everyone worry.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Then off-days are off-days, so we should 
make sure to enjoy them to the fullest, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Recharge your energy with a fun day off, 
and you'll definitely be able to give it 
your all tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Enjoying a day off... huh. Ines really is 
amazing...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I talked a big game, but I never 
would've realized it on my own.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"It's just, I had a reliable ally by my 
side. Though you can't take your eyes off 
her for a single second—"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"She's suuuper attentive and caring, 
always doing her absolute best to make 
sure I rest up."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
He's playful enough to pull off surprises, 
but he always thinks carefully about me 
and our family.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that person, I've had so much 
fun and learned how important it is to 
rest—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I can say I love every single 
bit of it. That's why, I—...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While searching for Ines Fujin, I found 
her on the sandy beach together with 
Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! What's the matter?
choice_data_list:
I'd like to have a meeting—do you have a 
moment now?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Okey-doke~! Well then, Ryan-chan, see you 
later!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Getting Ines to say something like 
that, her Trainer must really be something 
else.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, Trainer. Let's wrap this up 
real quick."
choice_data_list:
Yeah. By the way, what were you talking 
about earlier?

Yeah. By the way, what were you talking 
about just now?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: With Ryan-chan? Umm, well, you see~~...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...It's a secret with Big Sis Ines♪
